```{r setup, include=FALSE}
clean_context <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)

  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x) ~ "NoContext",
    tolower(x) %in% c("letters", "no context", "nocontext", "none", "na", "") ~ "NoContext",
    tolower(x) == "maze" ~ "Maze",
    tolower(x) == "melody" ~ "Melody",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}


clean_model_type <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)

  dplyr::case_when(
    # Low-scale baseline
    x %in% c(
      "Poor", "Lazy", "Low", "Low-Scale", "Low Scale"
    ) ~ "Low-Scale",

    # High-scale baseline
    x %in% c(
      "Rich", "High", "High-Scale", "High Scale"
    ) ~ "High-Scale",

    # Low global scale + high context scale
    x %in% c(
      "Lazy-Rich-Contex",
      "Lazy-Rich-Context",
      "Lazy+RichCtx",
      "Lazy Rich-Context",
      "Low-High-Contex",
      "Low-High-Context",
      "Low+HighCtx",
      "Low-Scale-High-Context",
      "Low-Scale + High Context"
    ) ~ "Low-Scale + High Context",

    # High global scale + low context scale
    x %in% c(
      "Rich-Lazy-Contex",
      "Rich-Lazy-Context",
      "Rich+LazyCtx",
      "Rich Lazy-Context",
      "High-Low-Contex",
      "High-Low-Context",
      "High+LowCtx",
      "High-Scale-Low-Context",
      "High-Scale + Low Context"
    ) ~ "High-Scale + Low Context",

    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# ============================================================
# LOSS fits (average) with NO FATIGUE term
# - Remove F from all sims/objectives/decoders
# - Still keeps "state-space" dynamics via x (and 2-state for Cross/Split)
#
# This is a drop-in set of replacements for:
#   simulate_state_Lump / objective_Lump / fit_model1_avg
#   simulate_state_Cross / objective_Cross / fit_model2_avg
#   objective_Split / fit_model3_avg
# plus the avg/overlay wrapper that uses LOSS.
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare raw model_type × counterbalance groups for bootstrap
# ------------------------------------------------------------

get_run_id_col <- function(df) {
  candidates <- c(
    "participant_id",
    "run_id",
    "network_id",
    "agent_id",
    "seed"
  )

  matches <- candidates[candidates %in% names(df)]

  if (length(matches) == 0L) {
    stop(
      "Could not identify the run-ID column. Available columns are: ",
      paste(names(df), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  matches[[1]]
}

bootstrap_raw_groups <- rich_poor_learning_dynamics %>%
  mutate(
    model_type = clean_model_type(model_type),
    model_type = factor(model_type, levels = model_levels)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(model_type),
    training_active
  ) %>%
  add_counterbalance() %>%
  filter(cb %in% c("MazeFirst", "MelodyFirst")) %>%
  group_by(model_type, cb) %>%
  group_split() %>%
  setNames(
    purrr::map_chr(
      .,
      ~ paste(
        as.character(unique(.x$model_type)),
        unique(.x$cb),
        sep = "__"
      )
    )
  )

rich_poor_learning_dynamics <- rich_poor_learning_dynamics %>%
  mutate(
    model_type = clean_model_type(model_type),
    model_type = factor(model_type, levels = model_levels)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(model_type))

check_len <- function(name, v, N) {
  if (length(v) != N) stop(sprintf("%s length mismatch: %d vs %d", name, length(v), N))
}

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b

rmse <- function(yhat, y) sqrt(mean((as.numeric(yhat) - as.numeric(y))^2, na.rm = TRUE))
make_X_noF <- function(Phi, x) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  if (length(x) != nrow(Phi)) {
    stop(sprintf("make_X_noF mismatch: length(x)=%d nrow(Phi)=%d", length(x), nrow(Phi)))
  }
  # data.frame guarantees all columns are length nrow(Phi) (no weird 1-row cbind results)
  Xdf <- data.frame(Phi, c_x = x, check.names = FALSE)
  as.matrix(Xdf)
}

# ---------- decoder (OLS) ----------
fit_decoder_ols <- function(y, X) {
  y <- as.numeric(y)
  X <- as.matrix(X)

  if (nrow(X) != length(y)) {
    stop(sprintf("fit_decoder_ols mismatch: nrow(X)=%d length(y)=%d",
                 nrow(X), length(y)))
  }

  qrX  <- qr(X)
  beta <- as.numeric(qr.coef(qrX, y))
  beta[is.na(beta)] <- 0
  yhat <- as.numeric(X %*% beta)

  list(coef = setNames(beta, colnames(X)), yhat = yhat)
}

add_counterbalance <- function(df) {
  # expects: participant_id, model_type, global_step, context
  starts <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(global_step), !is.na(context)) %>%
    arrange(participant_id, model_type, global_step) %>%
    group_by(participant_id, model_type) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    transmute(
      participant_id, model_type,
      start_context = as.character(context),
      cb = dplyr::case_when(
        start_context == "Maze" ~ "MazeFirst",
        start_context == "Melody" ~ "MelodyFirst",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    )

  df %>% left_join(starts, by = c("participant_id", "model_type"))
}

# ---------- bases robust to 1 context ----------
build_bases <- function(trialNum, seqNum, ctx) {
  # force plain vectors
  trialNum <- as.integer(trialNum)
  seqNum   <- as.integer(seqNum)
  ctx      <- as.character(ctx)

  N <- length(ctx)
  if (length(trialNum) != N || length(seqNum) != N) {
    stop(sprintf("build_bases input mismatch: trial=%d seq=%d ctx=%d",
                 length(trialNum), length(seqNum), N))
  }
  if (N < 2) {
    # return 1-row matrix explicitly
    return(cbind(Intercept = 1, ctx1 = 1))
  }

  u <- sort(unique(ctx))
  if (length(u) < 2) {
    return(cbind(Intercept = rep(1, N), ctx1 = rep(1, N)))
  }

  ctxf <- factor(ctx, levels = u)
  X <- model.matrix(~ ctxf - 1)
  colnames(X) <- gsub("^ctxf", "", colnames(X))
  cbind(Intercept = rep(1, N), X)
}


# ---------- prep + averaging (LOSS) ----------
prep_elman <- function(df, y_col = "loss") {
  stopifnot(y_col %in% names(df))
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[y_col]]),
           !is.na(block_id),
           !is.na(sequence_in_block)) %>%
    mutate(
      new_trialNumber = as.integer(block_id),
      sequenceNumber  = as.integer(sequence_in_block),
      global_step     = as.integer(global_step),
      context         = as.character(context),
      cb              = as.character(df$cb %||% NA_character_),
      meanY           = as.numeric(.data[[y_col]])
    ) %>%
    arrange(new_trialNumber, sequenceNumber, global_step)
}

make_avg_trace_cb <- function(df, y_col = "loss",
                              by = c("model_type", "cb")) {
  stopifnot(y_col %in% names(df))

  df %>%
    mutate(
  model_type = clean_model_type(model_type),
  model_type = factor(model_type, levels = model_levels)
) %>%
filter(!is.na(model_type)) %>%
    filter(training_active) %>%
    add_counterbalance() %>%
    filter(cb %in% c("MazeFirst", "MelodyFirst")) %>%  # drop "Other" if it exists
    group_by(across(all_of(c(by, "context", "block_id", "sequence_in_block")))) %>%
    summarise(y = mean(.data[[y_col]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(block_id, sequence_in_block) %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(by))) %>%
    mutate(global_step = row_number()) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    rename(!!y_col := y)
}

# ============================================================
# Lump: single-state, no fatigue
#   x_{n+1} = A * x_n
#   decode: y ~ bases + c_x * x
# params: A
# ============================================================
simulate_state_Lump_noF <- function(par, y) {
  A <- as.numeric(par["A"])
  N <- length(y)
  x <- numeric(N + 1L)
  x[1L] <- y[1L]
  for (n in seq_len(N)) x[n + 1L] <- A * x[n]
  list(x = x[-1L])
}

# context-free design matrix (intercept only)
Phi_intercept <- function(N) {
  X <- matrix(1, nrow = N, ncol = 1)
  colnames(X) <- "Intercept"
  X
}

objective_Lump_noF <- function(p, y, tr, sq, cx) {
  par <- setNames(as.numeric(p), "A")
  sim <- simulate_state_Lump_noF(par, y)

  N <- length(y)
  Phi <- Phi_intercept(N)              # <-- NO context bases
  X   <- data.frame(Phi, c_x = as.numeric(sim$x), check.names = FALSE) |> as.matrix()

  dec <- fit_decoder_ols(y, X)
  sum((dec$yhat - y)^2)
}

fit_model1_avg_noF <- function(df_avg, y_col = "loss") {
  dat <- prep_elman(df_avg, y_col = y_col)
  y  <- dat$meanY
  tr <- dat$new_trialNumber
  sq <- dat$sequenceNumber
  cx <- dat$context

  par0  <- c(A = 0.95)
  lower <- c(A = 0.60)
  upper <- c(A = 0.999)

  obj <- function(p) { val <- objective_Lump_noF(p, y, tr, sq, cx); if (!is.finite(val)) 1e12 else val }
  fit <- optim(par0, obj, method = "L-BFGS-B", lower = lower, upper = upper,
               control = list(maxit = 100000))
  par_hat <- setNames(fit$par, names(par0))

  sim <- simulate_state_Lump_noF(par_hat, y)

  N <- length(y)
  Phi <- Phi_intercept(N)              # <-- NO context bases
  X   <- data.frame(Phi, c_x = as.numeric(sim$x), check.names = FALSE) |> as.matrix()
  dec <- fit_decoder_ols(y, X)

  list(model="Lump_noF", par=par_hat, coef_decoder=dec$coef, rmse=rmse(dec$yhat, y),
       observed=y, predicted=dec$yhat, trials=tr, seqnum=sq, context=cx, data=dat,
       y_col = y_col)
}

# ============================================================
# Cross: two-state, no fatigue
#   x_{t+1} = A_mat %*% x_t  (A_diag, A_cross)
#   readout: x_obs = alpha_maze*x_maze + alpha_mel*x_mel (w_mix fixed 0.5 if Mixed exists)
#   decode: y ~ bases + c_x * x_obs
# params: A_diag, A_cross
# ============================================================
# ============================================================
# Cross vs Split (NO fatigue): context-gated 2-state models
# - Cross: cross-talk allowed (A_cross >= 0)
# - Split: no cross-talk (A_cross fixed = 0)
# - Same decoder class for both: yhat = b0 + bx * x_readout
# - Readout: Maze -> x_maze, Melody -> x_mel
#   (Mixed/NoContext -> blend w_mix if present)
# ============================================================

get_alphas <- function(c_lab, w_mix = 0.5) {
  if (c_lab == "Maze") {
    c(alpha_maze = 1, alpha_mel = 0)
  } else if (c_lab == "Melody") {
    c(alpha_maze = 0, alpha_mel = 1)
  } else if (c_lab %in% c("Mixed", "NoContext")) {
    c(alpha_maze = 1 - w_mix, alpha_mel = w_mix)
  } else {
    c(alpha_maze = 1, alpha_mel = 0)
  }
}

# ---------- context-gated simulator (Cross/Split share this; Split sets A_cross=0) ----------
simulate_state_twoctx_gated_noF <- function(par, y, cx, w_mix = 0.5, A_cross_override = NULL) {
  N <- length(y)

  A_Maze   <- as.numeric(par["A_Maze"])
  A_Melody <- as.numeric(par["A_Melody"])
  A_cross  <- as.numeric(par["A_cross"] %||% 0)

  if (!is.null(A_cross_override)) A_cross <- A_cross_override

  x_maze <- numeric(N + 1L)
  x_mel  <- numeric(N + 1L)
  x_maze[1L] <- y[1L]
  x_mel [1L] <- y[1L]

  x_readout <- numeric(N)

  for (t in seq_len(N)) {
    c_lab <- cx[t]
    a <- get_alphas(c_lab, w_mix = w_mix)

    # readout at time t (before updating)
    x_readout[t] <- a["alpha_maze"] * x_maze[t] + a["alpha_mel"] * x_mel[t]

    # gated update: only the "active" memory updates
    if (c_lab == "Maze") {
      x_maze[t + 1L] <- A_Maze * x_maze[t] + A_cross * x_mel[t]
      x_mel [t + 1L] <- x_mel[t]   # held
    } else if (c_lab == "Melody") {
      x_mel [t + 1L] <- A_Melody * x_mel[t] + A_cross * x_maze[t]
      x_maze[t + 1L] <- x_maze[t]  # held
    } else if (c_lab %in% c("Mixed", "NoContext")) {
      # optional: update both using blended exposure (keeps symmetry with your alpha scheme)
      # If you never have Mixed in SRN traces, this branch won't matter.
      x_maze[t + 1L] <- A_Maze   * x_maze[t] + A_cross * x_mel[t]
      x_mel [t + 1L] <- A_Melody * x_mel[t]  + A_cross * x_maze[t]
    } else {
      # default: treat like Maze
      x_maze[t + 1L] <- A_Maze * x_maze[t] + A_cross * x_mel[t]
      x_mel [t + 1L] <- x_mel[t]
    }
  }

  list(
    x_readout = x_readout,
    x_maze    = x_maze[-1L],
    x_mel     = x_mel[-1L]
  )
}

# ---------- Cross objective/fit (cross-talk estimated) ----------
objective_Cross_gated_noF <- function(p, y, cx) {
  par <- setNames(as.numeric(p), c("A_Maze", "A_cross", "A_Melody"))
  sim <- simulate_state_twoctx_gated_noF(par, y, cx, w_mix = 0.5)

  X <- cbind(Intercept = 1, c_x = as.numeric(sim$x_readout))
  dec <- fit_decoder_ols(y, X)
  sum((dec$yhat - y)^2)
}

fit_model2_avg_noF <- function(df_avg, y_col = "loss") {
  dat <- prep_elman(df_avg, y_col = y_col)
  y  <- dat$meanY
  cx <- dat$context

  par0  <- c(A_Maze = 0.95, A_cross = 0.02, A_Melody = 0.95)
  lower <- c(A_Maze = 0.60, A_cross = 0.00, A_Melody = 0.60)
  upper <- c(A_Maze = 0.999, A_cross = 0.50, A_Melody = 0.999)

  obj <- function(p) { v <- objective_Cross_gated_noF(p, y, cx); if (!is.finite(v)) 1e12 else v }
  fit <- optim(par0, obj, method="L-BFGS-B", lower=lower, upper=upper,
               control=list(maxit=100000))
  par_hat <- setNames(fit$par, names(par0))

  sim <- simulate_state_twoctx_gated_noF(par_hat, y, cx, w_mix = 0.5)
  X   <- cbind(Intercept = 1, c_x = as.numeric(sim$x_readout))
  dec <- fit_decoder_ols(y, X)

  list(model="Cross_noF", par=par_hat, coef_decoder=dec$coef, rmse=rmse(dec$yhat,y),
       observed=y, predicted=dec$yhat,
       trials=dat$new_trialNumber, seqnum=dat$sequenceNumber, context=cx,
       data=dat, y_col=y_col)
}

# ---------- Split objective/fit (NO cross-talk; A_cross fixed to 0) ----------
objective_Split_gated_noF <- function(p, y, cx) {
  # p: A_Maze, A_Melody (no A_cross)
  par <- setNames(as.numeric(p), c("A_Maze", "A_Melody"))
  sim <- simulate_state_twoctx_gated_noF(
    c(par, A_cross = 0),
    y, cx, w_mix = 0.5,
    A_cross_override = 0
  )

  X <- cbind(Intercept = 1, c_x = as.numeric(sim$x_readout))
  dec <- fit_decoder_ols(y, X)
  sum((dec$yhat - y)^2)
}

fit_model3_avg_noF <- function(df_avg, y_col = "loss") {
  dat <- prep_elman(df_avg, y_col = y_col)
  y  <- dat$meanY
  cx <- dat$context

  par0  <- c(A_Maze = 0.95, A_Melody = 0.95)
  lower <- c(A_Maze = 0.60, A_Melody = 0.60)
  upper <- c(A_Maze = 0.999, A_Melody = 0.999)

  obj <- function(p) { v <- objective_Split_gated_noF(p, y, cx); if (!is.finite(v)) 1e12 else v }
  fit <- optim(par0, obj, method="L-BFGS-B", lower=lower, upper=upper,
               control=list(maxit=100000))
  par_hat <- setNames(fit$par, names(par0))

  sim <- simulate_state_twoctx_gated_noF(
    c(par_hat, A_cross = 0),
    y, cx, w_mix = 0.5,
    A_cross_override = 0
  )
  X   <- cbind(Intercept = 1, c_x = as.numeric(sim$x_readout))
  dec <- fit_decoder_ols(y, X)

  list(model="Split_noF", par=par_hat, coef_decoder=dec$coef, rmse=rmse(dec$yhat,y),
       observed=y, predicted=dec$yhat,
       trials=dat$new_trialNumber, seqnum=dat$sequenceNumber, context=cx,
       data=dat, y_col=y_col)
}



# ---------- wrapper + plot ----------
fit_three_models_on_avg_noF <- function(df_avg, y_col = "loss") {
  Lump <- fit_model1_avg_noF(df_avg, y_col = y_col)
  Cross <- fit_model2_avg_noF(df_avg, y_col = y_col)
  Split <- fit_model3_avg_noF(df_avg, y_col = y_col)

  dat <- prep_elman(df_avg, y_col = y_col)

  overlay <- tibble(
    global_step = dat$global_step,
    block_id    = dat$new_trialNumber,
    seq_in_blk  = dat$sequenceNumber,
    context     = dat$context,
    observed    = dat$meanY,
    Lump          = as.numeric(Lump$predicted),
    Cross          = as.numeric(Cross$predicted),
    Split          = as.numeric(Split$predicted)
  ) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(observed, Lump, Cross, Split),
                 names_to = "series", values_to = "y") %>%
    mutate(series = factor(series, levels = c("observed","Lump","Cross","Split")))

  list(fits = list(Lump=Lump, Cross=Cross, Split=Split), df = overlay, y_col = y_col)
}

cols <- c("red", "blue", "purple")

plot_avg_overlay_noF <- function(fit_obj, title = NULL) {
  df <- fit_obj$df
  ylab <- fit_obj$y_col %||% "loss"

  obs <- df %>% filter(series == "observed") %>% arrange(global_step)
  cuts <- which(diff(obs$block_id) != 0L)
  vlines <- if (length(cuts)) tibble(xint = obs$global_step[cuts] + 0.5) else NULL

  ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = obs, aes(x = global_step, y = y, color = context),
               size = 6) +
    geom_line(data = obs, aes(x = global_step, y = y, color = context, group = interaction(context, block_id)),
              linewidth = 3, alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_line(data = df %>% filter(series != "observed"),
              aes(x = global_step, y = y, linetype = series),
              linewidth = 4)  +
    labs(x="Global step", y=ylab, linetype="Model") +
theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 2),
        legend.key.size = unit(2, 'cm'),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 30),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 34)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
}

# add parameter recovery / bootstrapping
simulate_from_fit_noF <- function(fit_obj, sigma = NULL, seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)
  yhat <- as.numeric(fit_obj$predicted)
  yobs <- as.numeric(fit_obj$observed)

  if (is.null(sigma)) {
    sigma <- sd(yobs - yhat, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (!is.finite(sigma) || sigma <= 0) sigma <- 1e-3
  }

  ysim <- yhat + rnorm(length(yhat), mean = 0, sd = sigma)

  # return a df shaped like an avg trace (same covariates)
  dat <- fit_obj$data
  out <- tibble(
    block_id = dat$new_trialNumber,
    sequence_in_block = dat$sequenceNumber,
    global_step = dat$global_step,
    context = dat$context,
    cb = dat$cb %||% NA_character_,
    loss = ysim
  )
  out
}

refit_model_noF <- function(model_name, df_sim, y_col = "loss") {
  
  switch(
    model_name,
    Lump = fit_model1_avg_noF(df_sim, y_col = y_col),
    Cross  = fit_model2_avg_noF(df_sim, y_col = y_col),
    Split  = fit_model3_avg_noF(df_sim, y_col = y_col),
    stop("Unknown model name: ", model_name)
  )
}

extract_params <- function(fit_three, group_label = NA_character_) {
  
  purrr::imap_dfr(
    fit_three$fits,
    function(fit_obj, model_name) {
      tibble(
        group = group_label,
        model = model_name,
        param = names(fit_obj$par),
        estimate = as.numeric(fit_obj$par)
      )
    }
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Part 1. Noise-free parameter recovery
# ============================================================
# This uses the fitted model as the data-generating model.
# No noise is added.
#
# Question:
# If the data were generated exactly by the fitted model,
# can the fitting procedure recover the known parameters?
# ============================================================

simulate_from_fit_no_noise <- function(fit_obj) {
  
  dat <- fit_obj$data
  
  tibble(
    block_id = dat$new_trialNumber,
    sequence_in_block = dat$sequenceNumber,
    global_step = dat$global_step,
    context = dat$context,
    cb = dat$cb %||% NA_character_,
    loss = as.numeric(fit_obj$predicted)
  )
}

recover_params_no_noise_one <- function(fit_three) {
  
  purrr::imap_dfr(
    fit_three$fits,
    function(fit0, model_name) {
      
      par_true <- fit0$par
      
      sim_df <- simulate_from_fit_no_noise(fit0)
      
      refit <- refit_model_noF(
        model_name = model_name,
        df_sim = sim_df,
        y_col = "loss"
      )
      
      tibble(
        model = model_name,
        param = names(refit$par),
        true = as.numeric(par_true[names(refit$par)]),
        recovered = as.numeric(refit$par),
        bias = recovered - true,
        abs_error = abs(recovered - true)
      )
    }
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Part 2. Nonparametric bootstrap CIs for parameter estimates
# ============================================================
# This resamples network runs / participants with replacement.
#
# Question:
# How stable are the fitted parameters across plausible resamples
# of the observed SRN runs?
# ============================================================

# Try to find the run identifier column automatically.
# Change this manually if your run ID has a different name.
# ============================================================
# Fast bootstrap CIs
# - assumes bootstrap_raw_groups already exists
# - avoids duplicating sampled runs
# - skips overlay creation
# - optionally fits only selected models
# - parallelizes across bootstrap reps
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(future)
library(furrr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Fit-only wrapper: no overlay dataframe
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fit_models_fast_noF <- function(df_avg, y_col = "loss",
                                models = c("Lump", "Cross", "Split")) {
  
  fits <- list()
  
  if ("Lump" %in% models) {
    fits$Lump <- fit_model1_avg_noF(df_avg, y_col = y_col)
  }
  
  if ("Cross" %in% models) {
    fits$Cross <- fit_model2_avg_noF(df_avg, y_col = y_col)
  }
  
  if ("Split" %in% models) {
    fits$Split <- fit_model3_avg_noF(df_avg, y_col = y_col)
  }
  
  list(fits = fits, y_col = y_col)
}

extract_params <- function(fit_obj, group_label = NA_character_) {
  
  purrr::imap_dfr(
    fit_obj$fits,
    function(one_fit, model_name) {
      tibble(
        group = group_label,
        model = model_name,
        param = names(one_fit$par),
        estimate = as.numeric(one_fit$par)
      )
    }
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Run-level trace for one already-split group
# ------------------------------------------------------------

make_run_trace_one_group <- function(group_raw, y_col = "loss") {
  
  run_id_col <- get_run_id_col(group_raw)
  
  group_raw %>%
    filter(training_active) %>%
    mutate(run_id_boot = .data[[run_id_col]]) %>%
    group_by(run_id_boot, context, block_id, sequence_in_block) %>%
    summarise(
      y = mean(.data[[y_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rename(!!y_col := y)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Weighted bootstrap average
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Instead of duplicating rows for sampled runs, count how many
# times each run was sampled and compute a weighted mean.

make_weighted_boot_avg <- function(run_trace, sampled_ids, y_col = "loss") {
  
  boot_weights <- tibble(run_id_boot = sampled_ids) %>%
    count(run_id_boot, name = "boot_w")
  
  run_trace %>%
    inner_join(boot_weights, by = "run_id_boot") %>%
    group_by(context, block_id, sequence_in_block) %>%
    summarise(
      y = weighted.mean(.data[[y_col]], w = boot_w, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(block_id, sequence_in_block) %>%
    mutate(global_step = row_number()) %>%
    rename(!!y_col := y)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Fast bootstrap for one group
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bootstrap_params_one_group_fast <- function(
    group_key,
    raw_groups,
    R = 200,
    seed = 123,
    models = c("Lump", "Cross", "Split")) {

  group_raw <- raw_groups[[group_key]]

  if (is.null(group_raw)) {
    stop(
      "No raw dataframe found for group: ", group_key,
      "\nAvailable groups: ",
      paste(names(raw_groups), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  run_trace <- make_run_trace_one_group(
    group_raw,
    y_col = "loss"
  )

  run_ids <- unique(run_trace$run_id_boot)

  if (length(run_ids) < 2) {
    stop("Need at least two runs to bootstrap group: ", group_key)
  }

  set.seed(seed)

  boot_samples <- replicate(
    R,
    sample(
      run_ids,
      size = length(run_ids),
      replace = TRUE
    ),
    simplify = FALSE
  )

  future_map_dfr(
    seq_len(R),
    function(r) {

      boot_avg <- make_weighted_boot_avg(
        run_trace = run_trace,
        sampled_ids = boot_samples[[r]],
        y_col = "loss"
      )

      boot_fit <- tryCatch(
        fit_models_fast_noF(
          boot_avg,
          y_col = "loss",
          models = models
        ),
        error = function(e) {
          warning(
            "Bootstrap fit failed for group ",
            group_key,
            ", replicate ",
            r,
            ": ",
            conditionMessage(e)
          )
          NULL
        }
      )

      if (is.null(boot_fit)) {
        return(
          tibble(
            .rep = r,
            group = group_key,
            model = NA_character_,
            param = NA_character_,
            estimate = NA_real_
          )
        )
      }

      extract_params(
        boot_fit,
        group_label = group_key
      ) %>%
        mutate(.rep = r, .before = group)
    },
    .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
  )
}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Parallel setup
# ------------------------------------------------------------

n_workers <- max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1)
future::plan(multisession, workers = n_workers)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Run bootstrap
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Start with R = 50 to test.
# Then use R = 200.
# Only use R = 500 or 1000 for the final table.

models_to_bootstrap <- c("Lump", "Cross", "Split")

bootstrap_param_estimates_fast <- purrr::map_dfr(
  names(avg_fits_cb),
  function(group_key) {
    bootstrap_params_one_group_fast(
      group_key = group_key,
      raw_groups = bootstrap_raw_groups,
      R = 200,
      seed = 123,
      models = models_to_bootstrap
    )
  }
) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(model),
    !is.na(param),
    !is.na(estimate)
  )
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Original parameter estimates
# ------------------------------------------------------------

original_param_estimates <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  avg_fits_cb,
  function(fit_three, key) {
    extract_params(fit_three, group_label = key)
  }
) %>%
  rename(original_estimate = estimate)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Bootstrap percentile CIs
# ------------------------------------------------------------

bootstrap_param_ci_fast <- bootstrap_param_estimates_fast %>%
  group_by(group, model, param) %>%
  summarise(
    boot_mean = mean(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    boot_sd = sd(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    ci_low = quantile(estimate, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    ci_high = quantile(estimate, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_boot = sum(!is.na(estimate)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    original_param_estimates,
    by = c("group", "model", "param")
  ) %>%
  select(
    group,
    model,
    param,
    original_estimate,
    boot_mean,
    boot_sd,
    ci_low,
    ci_high,
    n_boot
  )

bootstrap_param_ci_fast
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
bic_from_fit <- function(fit_obj, k) {
  y <- as.numeric(fit_obj$observed)
  yhat <- as.numeric(fit_obj$predicted)

  ok <- is.finite(y) & is.finite(yhat)
  y <- y[ok]
  yhat <- yhat[ok]

  n <- length(y)
  rss <- sum((y - yhat)^2)

  # guard against log(0)
  rss <- max(rss, .Machine$double.eps)

  bic <- n * log(rss / n) + k * log(n)

  tibble(
    model = fit_obj$model,
    n = n,
    k = k,
    rss = rss,
    rmse = sqrt(mean((y - yhat)^2)),
    bic = bic
  )
}

bic_table_from_threefit <- function(fit_three_obj) {
  bind_rows(
    bic_from_fit(fit_three_obj$fits$Lump, k = 3),
    bic_from_fit(fit_three_obj$fits$Cross, k = 5),
    bic_from_fit(fit_three_obj$fits$Split, k = 4)
  ) %>%
    arrange(bic) %>%
    mutate(
      delta_bic = bic - min(bic),
      bic_weight = exp(-0.5 * delta_bic) / sum(exp(-0.5 * delta_bic))
    )
}

bic_tbl_cb <- purrr::imap_dfr(avg_fits_cb, function(fit_obj, key) {
  bic_table_from_threefit(fit_obj) %>%
    mutate(key = key, .before = 1)
}) %>%
  tidyr::separate(key, into = c("model_type", "cb"), sep = "__", remove = FALSE) %>%
  arrange(model_type, cb, bic)

bic_tbl_cb

bic_tbl_wide <- bic_tbl_cb %>%
  select(model_type, cb, model, bic, delta_bic, bic_weight) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = model,
    values_from = c(bic, delta_bic, bic_weight)
  )

bic_tbl_wide

bic_tbl_paper <- bic_tbl_cb %>%
  mutate(
    model_type = clean_model_type(model_type),
    model_type = factor(model_type, levels = model_levels),
    model = dplyr::recode(
      model,
      "Lump_noF" = "Lump",
      "Cross_noF" = "Cross",
      "Split_noF" = "Split"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(model_type)) %>%
  group_by(model_type, model) %>%
  summarise(
    bic_sum = sum(bic, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(model_type) %>%
  mutate(
    delta_bic = bic_sum - min(bic_sum),
    winner = ifelse(delta_bic == 0, "Yes", "")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(model_type, bic_sum)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = label,
      fontface = ifelse(winner, "bold", "plain")
    ),
    size = 12
  ) +
  geom_tile(
    data = bic_heat_df %>% filter(winner),
    fill = NA,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 2.2
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    source ~ .,
    scales = "free_y",
    space = "free_y",
    switch = "y"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "blue",
    high = "red",
    trans = scales::pseudo_log_trans(sigma = 1),
    name = expression(Delta * "BIC")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "State-space model",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),

    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(
      angle = 0,
      size = 36,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 36,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 36
    ),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 36,
      margin = margin(t = 15)
    ),

    legend.title = element_text(size = 22),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),

    panel.spacing.y = unit(0.8, "lines")
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.key.height = unit(3.5, "cm"),
    legend.key.width  = unit(1.2, "cm"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 26),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 22)
  )

BIC_heatmap_grouped
```
